one_minute_value_explanation: v11.8 lets operators see whether provider-read evidence is current, stale, expired, or unknown before reusing it for decisions.
thirty_second_version_delta: v11.7 showed provider-read decision state; v11.8 adds freshness governance so old evidence cannot be silently reused as current.
product_review_trigger: If an operator cannot tell whether provider-read evidence is current enough to reuse, reopen this capability as a product issue.
not_proven: Capability delta does not prove provider truth, market value, or broad adoption.
